source: P2-5 种子库 + typogrammar.com 免费 PDF(仅供本地个人学习)(Task1 指南句式)+ 人工整理

patterns.name: It is widely believed that …
patterns.cn: 人们普遍认为……(观点引入)
patterns.template: It is widely believed that + 从句
patterns.example: It is widely believed that higher education plays a decisive role in career development.
patterns.exampleCn: 人们普遍认为,高等教育在职业发展中起着决定性作用。
tips: 适合开头段引入普遍观点
后文可接 However/While 引出自己的立场

patterns.name: There is no doubt that …
patterns.template: There is no doubt that + 从句
patterns.example: There is no doubt that traffic congestion has become a pressing urban issue.
patterns.exampleCn: 毫无疑问,交通拥堵已成为一个紧迫的城市问题。
tips: 语气强,观点立场必须站得住
注意 doubt 后接 that 从句(肯定句中也可用 whether)

patterns.name: One compelling argument in favour of … is that …
patterns.cn: 支持……的一个有力论点是……(论证)
patterns.template: One compelling argument in favour of / against + 名词 is that + 从句
patterns.example: One compelling argument in favour of remote work is that it gives employees greater flexibility.
patterns.exampleCn: 支持远程办公的一个有力论点是它给了员工更大的灵活性。
tips: 主体段首句展开分论点
argument 后可换 benefit/drawback

patterns.name: While it is true that …, it must be acknowledged that …
patterns.cn: 虽然……没错,但也必须承认……(让步反驳)
patterns.template: While it is true that + 从句, it must be acknowledged that + 从句
patterns.example: While it is true that technology saves time, it must be acknowledged that it can also be a source of distraction.
patterns.exampleCn: 虽然技术确实节省时间,但也必须承认它可能让人分心。
tips: 讨论双边题型的高分句式
两半句用逗号连接,不用 but

patterns.name: The primary reason for this is that …
patterns.template: The primary reason for + 名词 is that + 从句
patterns.example: The primary reason for this trend is that young people now value experiences over possessions.
patterns.exampleCn: 这一趋势的首要原因是,年轻人如今更看重体验而非物质。
tips: reason for 后接名词/动名词
可替换 primary → key/main

patterns.name: This can be attributed to …
patterns.cn: 这可以归因于……(学术归因)
patterns.template: This (phenomenon/trend) can be attributed to + 名词/动名词
patterns.example: The sharp decline in birth rates can be attributed to rising living costs.
patterns.exampleCn: 出生率的急剧下降可归因于不断上升的生活成本。
tips: attribute A to B:A 被归因于 B
被动语态是学术写作高频结构

patterns.name: In contrast to A, B …
patterns.template: In contrast to + 名词, + 名词 + 谓语
patterns.example: In contrast to urban areas, rural regions saw a modest rise of only 2%.
patterns.exampleCn: 与城市地区相比,农村地区仅小幅上升了 2%。
tips: 也可用 By contrast, 开头
对比项必须同类可比

patterns.name: The figure rose dramatically from … to …
patterns.cn: 数字从……急剧上升到……(趋势描述)
patterns.template: The figure rose/fell dramatically from + 数值 to + 数值 over the period.
patterns.example: The figure for car ownership rose dramatically from 40% to 78% over the period.
patterns.exampleCn: 汽车拥有率在此期间从 40% 急剧上升到 78%。
tips: dramatically 可换 sharply/significantly/slightly
over the period 呼应图表时间跨度

patterns.name: X is expected to witness a steady increase
patterns.cn: 预计 X 将迎来稳步增长(预测)
patterns.template: X is expected/predicted to witness + 趋势名词
patterns.example: Online sales are expected to witness a steady increase over the next decade.
patterns.exampleCn: 预计未来十年网络销售额将稳步增长。
tips: witness 拟人化写法,图表作文加分
主语一般不是人

patterns.name: Only by doing X can we …
patterns.cn: 只有通过做 X,我们才能……(倒装强调)
patterns.template: Only by + doing + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 动词原形
patterns.example: Only by raising public awareness can we reverse this worrying trend.
patterns.exampleCn: 只有提高公众意识,我们才能扭转这一令人担忧的趋势。
tips: Only 开头+状语 → 主句部分倒装
倒装后语序:can we / will they / does it

patterns.name: Not only does X …, but it also …
patterns.cn: X 不仅……,而且……(递进倒装)
patterns.template: Not only + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词原形, but + 主语 + also + 谓语
patterns.example: Not only does regular exercise improve health, but it also relieves stress.
patterns.exampleCn: 规律运动不仅能改善健康,还能缓解压力。
tips: Not only 置于句首 → 前半句部分倒装
后半句用正常语序

patterns.name: Provided that …, X will …
patterns.template: Provided that + 从句, + 主句
patterns.example: Provided that proper supervision is in place, children can benefit greatly from the internet.
patterns.exampleCn: 只要有适当的监管,儿童就能从互联网中大大受益。
tips: provided that ≈ as long as ≈ if
书面语气比 if 更强,注意从句用一般现在时表将来

patterns.name: The bar chart shows the number of international students at five…
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The bar chart shows the number of international students at five UK universities in 2022.
patterns.example: The bar chart shows the number of international students at five UK universities in 2022.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The bar chart compares five UK universities in terms of their in…
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The bar chart compares five UK universities in terms of their international student enrolment in 2022.
patterns.example: The bar chart compares five UK universities in terms of their international student enrolment in 2022.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The bar chart shows the percentage of men and women who did regu…
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The bar chart shows the percentage of men and women who did regular exercise in 2019.
patterns.example: The bar chart shows the percentage of men and women who did regular exercise in 2019.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The bar chart compares the proportion of men and women engaging …
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The bar chart compares the proportion of men and women engaging in regular physical exercise in 2019.
patterns.example: The bar chart compares the proportion of men and women engaging in regular physical exercise in 2019.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The pie chart shows the world's energy production by source in 2…
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The pie chart shows the world's energy production by source in 2023.
patterns.example: The pie chart shows the world's energy production by source in 2023.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The bar chart shows the amount of money spent on five different …
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The bar chart shows the amount of money spent on five different categories in four countries.
patterns.example: The bar chart shows the amount of money spent on five different categories in four countries.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The bar chart compares expenditure across five categories in fou…
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The bar chart compares expenditure across five categories in four countries, allowing both within-country and between-country comparisons.
patterns.example: The bar chart compares expenditure across five categories in four countries, allowing both within-country and between-country comparisons.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The bar chart compares [what is measured] across [number] [categ…
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The bar chart compares [what is measured] across [number] [categories] in [year or time period].
patterns.example: The bar chart compares [what is measured] across [number] [categories] in [year or time period].
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The bar chart compares the number of international students enro…
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The bar chart compares the number of international students enrolled at five universities in the United Kingdom in 2023.
patterns.example: The bar chart compares the number of international students enrolled at five universities in the United Kingdom in 2023.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The pie chart shows that 35% housing, 20% transport, 15% food.
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The pie chart shows that 35% housing, 20% transport, 15% food.
patterns.example: The pie chart shows that 35% housing, 20% transport, 15% food.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: The pie chart shows that housing accounted for 35 percent of the…
patterns.cn: 图表作文高分句式(typogrammar Task 1 指南)
patterns.template: The pie chart shows that housing accounted for 35 percent of the total, followed by transport at 20 percent and food at 15 percent.
patterns.example: The pie chart shows that housing accounted for 35 percent of the total, followed by transport at 20 percent and food at 15 percent.
patterns.exampleCn: 见原句(图表作文示范句式)
tips: Task 1 图表描述常用句式
注意时态与数值表达准确

patterns.name: It is often argued that …
patterns.cn: 人们常说……(引入争议话题)
patterns.template: It is often argued that …
patterns.example: It is often argued that young people spend too much time online.
patterns.exampleCn: 人们常说年轻人上网时间过多。
tips: 开头段引入双边观点,常与 while others believe 搭配

patterns.name: Some people claim that …, while others maintain that …
patterns.cn: 有人主张……,而另一些人坚持……
patterns.template: Some people claim that …, while others maintain that …
patterns.example: Some people claim that money brings happiness, while others maintain that true joy comes from relationships.
patterns.exampleCn: 有人认为金钱带来幸福,而另一些人坚持真正的快乐来自人际关系。
tips: 讨论类开头经典框架,两方观点都要概述

patterns.name: From my perspective, …
patterns.template: From my perspective, …
patterns.example: From my perspective, the benefits of urbanisation outweigh its drawbacks.
patterns.exampleCn: 在我看来,城市化的好处大于坏处。
tips: 表明立场,比 in my opinion 更书面

patterns.name: I am inclined to believe that …
patterns.template: I am inclined to believe that …
patterns.example: I am inclined to believe that governments should invest more in public transport.
patterns.exampleCn: 我倾向于认为政府应加大对公共交通的投入。
tips: 温和表达立场,论证型作文可用

patterns.name: A case in point is …
patterns.template: A case in point is …
patterns.example: A case in point is the rapid growth of electric vehicles in China.
patterns.exampleCn: 一个典型例子是中国电动汽车的快速增长。
tips: 引出具体例证,替代 for example

patterns.name: This is particularly true when it comes to …
patterns.template: This is particularly true when it comes to …
patterns.example: This is particularly true when it comes to rural education.
patterns.exampleCn: 在乡村教育方面尤其如此。
tips: 聚焦话题某一方面,段落过渡自然

patterns.name: The advantages of … far outweigh the disadvantages
patterns.template: The advantages of … far outweigh the disadvantages
patterns.example: The advantages of telecommuting far outweigh the disadvantages for most knowledge workers.
patterns.exampleCn: 对多数知识工作者而言,远程办公利远大于弊。
tips: 讨论类结论句,立场鲜明

patterns.name: There is a growing body of evidence suggesting that …
patterns.template: There is a growing body of evidence suggesting that …
patterns.example: There is a growing body of evidence suggesting that regular exercise boosts mental health.
patterns.exampleCn: 越来越多的证据表明,规律运动能促进心理健康。
tips: 学术化证据引入,报告类作文高分句式

patterns.name: X has become a matter of public concern
patterns.cn: X 已成为公众关注的问题
patterns.template: X has become a matter of public concern
patterns.example: Air pollution has become a matter of public concern in many megacities.
patterns.exampleCn: 空气污染已成为许多特大城市公众关注的问题。
tips: 报告类开头指出问题

patterns.name: The underlying causes of this problem are threefold
patterns.cn: 这一问题的深层原因有三
patterns.template: The underlying causes of this problem are threefold
patterns.example: The underlying causes of this problem are threefold: poverty, poor infrastructure and weak governance.
patterns.exampleCn: 这一问题的深层原因有三:贫困、基础设施薄弱与治理不力。
tips: 报告类主体段总起句

patterns.name: Measures must be taken to address …
patterns.template: Measures must be taken to address …
patterns.example: Measures must be taken to address the rising cost of housing.
patterns.exampleCn: 必须采取措施应对不断上涨的住房成本。
tips: 结尾段提出解决建议

patterns.name: Only in this way can …
patterns.template: Only in this way can …
patterns.example: Only in this way can we achieve a truly sustainable society.
patterns.exampleCn: 只有这样,我们才能建成真正可持续的社会。
tips: 倒装强调,结尾段收束有力

patterns.name: It is high time that …
patterns.template: It is high time that …
patterns.example: It is high time that governments took decisive action on climate change.
patterns.exampleCn: 现在是各国政府对气候变化采取果断行动的时候了。
tips: 注意从句用过去式(虚拟语气)

patterns.name: The phenomenon can be explained by a combination of factors
patterns.cn: 这一现象可由多种因素共同解释
patterns.template: The phenomenon can be explained by a combination of factors
patterns.example: The phenomenon can be explained by a combination of economic and cultural factors.
patterns.exampleCn: 这一现象可由经济与文化因素共同解释。
tips: 报告类主体段总起

patterns.name: A growing number of people are …
patterns.template: A growing number of people are …
patterns.example: A growing number of people are choosing to work as freelancers.
patterns.exampleCn: 越来越多的人选择自由职业。
tips: 数量趋势表达,替代 more and more

patterns.name: It cannot be denied that …
patterns.template: It cannot be denied that …
patterns.example: It cannot be denied that technology has transformed education.
patterns.exampleCn: 不可否认,技术已改变教育。
tips: 承认对方观点,常后接 however 转折

patterns.name: Whether … is a matter of heated debate
patterns.template: Whether … is a matter of heated debate
patterns.example: Whether artificial intelligence will replace teachers is a matter of heated debate.
patterns.exampleCn: 人工智能是否会取代教师是激烈争论的话题。
tips: 讨论类开头

patterns.name: The trend towards … shows no sign of abating
patterns.template: The trend towards … shows no sign of abating
patterns.example: The trend towards online shopping shows no sign of abating.
patterns.exampleCn: 网上购物的趋势没有减弱的迹象。
tips: 趋势句,Task 1 结尾可用来预测

patterns.name: X accounts for the largest proportion of …
patterns.template: X accounts for the largest proportion of …
patterns.example: Private cars account for the largest proportion of urban emissions.
patterns.exampleCn: 私家车在城市排放中占比最大。
tips: 图表作文占比表达

patterns.name: The period between … and … witnessed a marked change in …
patterns.cn: 从……到……期间,……发生了显著变化
patterns.template: The period between … and … witnessed a marked change in …
patterns.example: The period between 2000 and 2020 witnessed a marked change in household energy use.
patterns.exampleCn: 2000 至 2020 年间,家庭能源使用发生了显著变化。
tips: witness 拟人化,Task 1 总述句

patterns.name: There was a threefold increase in …
patterns.template: There was a threefold increase in …
patterns.example: There was a threefold increase in renewable energy capacity.
patterns.exampleCn: 可再生能源装机容量增长了三倍。
tips: 倍数表达:threefold/twofold

patterns.name: The majority of …, with the remainder …
patterns.template: The majority of …, with the remainder …
patterns.example: The majority of commuters used private cars, with the remainder relying on public transport.
patterns.exampleCn: 大多数通勤者使用私家车,其余依赖公共交通。
tips: 份额拆分表达

patterns.name: By contrast, …
patterns.template: By contrast, …
patterns.example: By contrast, spending on books remained almost unchanged.
patterns.exampleCn: 相比之下,购书支出几乎保持不变。
tips: 对比转折,Task 1 分组描述

patterns.name: A similar pattern can be observed in …
patterns.cn: 在……中也能观察到相似模式
patterns.template: A similar pattern can be observed in …
patterns.example: A similar pattern can be observed in the data for rural households.
patterns.exampleCn: 农村家庭的数据中也能观察到相似模式。
tips: Task 1 分组比较

patterns.name: This can be largely attributed to …
patterns.cn: 这在很大程度上可归因于……
patterns.template: This can be largely attributed to …
patterns.example: This can be largely attributed to improved access to healthcare.
patterns.exampleCn: 这在很大程度上可归因于医疗服务可及性的提高。
tips: 归因表达,学术语气

patterns.name: It is worth noting that …
patterns.template: It is worth noting that …
patterns.example: It is worth noting that the figures do not include informal employment.
patterns.exampleCn: 值得注意的是,数据未包含非正规就业。
tips: 提示重要细节,写作与图表均可

patterns.name: The argument in favour of … rests on the assumption that …
patterns.cn: 支持……的论点基于……的假设
patterns.template: The argument in favour of … rests on the assumption that …
patterns.example: The argument in favour of school uniforms rests on the assumption that they reduce inequality.
patterns.exampleCn: 支持校服的论点基于校服能减少不平等的假设。
tips: 拆解对方论证的高阶句式

patterns.name: Provided that …, there is no reason why …
patterns.template: Provided that …, there is no reason why …
patterns.example: Provided that safety rules are followed, there is no reason why children should not cycle to school.
patterns.exampleCn: 只要遵守安全规则,就没有理由不让孩子们骑车上学。
tips: 条件句 + 双重否定,语气强

patterns.name: What matters most is not …, but …
patterns.template: What matters most is not …, but …
patterns.example: What matters most is not the quantity of homework, but its quality.
patterns.exampleCn: 最重要的不是作业的数量,而是质量。
tips: 主语从句强调,观点句高分结构

patterns.name: It is the responsibility of … to …
patterns.template: It is the responsibility of … to …
patterns.example: It is the responsibility of parents to guide their children's use of screens.
patterns.exampleCn: 引导孩子使用屏幕是父母的责任。
tips: 责任归属表达

patterns.name: Without …, it would be impossible to …
patterns.template: Without …, it would be impossible to …
patterns.example: Without international cooperation, it would be impossible to tackle climate change.
patterns.exampleCn: 没有国际合作,就不可能应对气候变化。
tips: 虚拟语气论证必要性

patterns.name: Far from being a threat, …
patterns.template: Far from being a threat, …
patterns.example: Far from being a threat, immigration has enriched the local economy.
patterns.exampleCn: 移民远非威胁,反而丰富了当地经济。
tips: 反驳对立观点的高分开头

patterns.name: The benefits of this approach are twofold
patterns.template: The benefits of this approach are twofold
patterns.example: The benefits of this approach are twofold: lower costs and higher efficiency.
patterns.exampleCn: 这种方法的好处有二:成本更低、效率更高。
tips: twofold/threefold 总分结构

patterns.name: Admittedly, …
patterns.template: Admittedly, …
patterns.example: Admittedly, space exploration is extremely expensive.
patterns.exampleCn: 诚然,太空探索极其昂贵。
tips: 让步段开头,后接 however

patterns.name: This raises the question of whether …
patterns.template: This raises the question of whether …
patterns.example: This raises the question of whether economic growth can be decoupled from emissions.
patterns.exampleCn: 这引出了经济增长能否与排放脱钩的问题。
tips: 承上启下引出讨论

patterns.name: In light of the above, …
patterns.template: In light of the above, …
patterns.example: In light of the above, the case for stricter regulation is compelling.
patterns.exampleCn: 鉴于以上分析,加强监管的理由很有说服力。
tips: 结论段总起

patterns.name: … is often cited as the main culprit
patterns.template: … is often cited as the main culprit
patterns.example: Car dependence is often cited as the main culprit behind urban congestion.
patterns.exampleCn: 对汽车的依赖常被指为城市拥堵的主要元凶。
tips: 归因句,报告类常用

patterns.name: The advantages are not confined to …
patterns.template: The advantages are not confined to …
patterns.example: The advantages of bilingual education are not confined to language skills.
patterns.exampleCn: 双语教育的好处不仅限于语言能力。
tips: not confined to = 不局限于

patterns.name: It is essential that …
patterns.template: It is essential that …
patterns.example: It is essential that every child have access to quality education.
patterns.exampleCn: 每个孩子都能接受优质教育至关重要。
